plan.title: Live RFQ Edit Evaluation Time Window

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ directly on its Responses tab.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Apply the tenant configuration required for this scenario.
Keep withdrawal available during live submission as required.
Apply the vendor-masking configuration required by the case.
Open Edit Evaluation Time from the RFQ stage Settings menu without confirming any change.
Verify that the Edit Evaluation Time window opened.
Verify the dialog offers evaluation-duration editing.
Verify the dialog offers evaluation-ending-time editing.
Verify the dialog has a Cancel button and remains unconfirmed.
Verify the dialog has an Ok button while no event change has been submitted.
